enrollment: Eight fresh development problems; retain all ineligible cases without replacement. Conditional-on-checkpoint qualification, not a full deployment trial.
comparison: Common candidate pool, all selector choices saved before downstream outcomes. Continue receives full remaining generator budget; every branch is charged the entire pool, including discarded candidates. Local selector generation/prefill/time are additionally recorded, not hidden inside a claim of total-compute matching.
fallback: Missing cheap scores select first candidate; invalid local output selects likelihood choice. No retries.
limitations: Entropy-reduction ranking is a GUARD-inspired component, not a full published-method reproduction. Same generator backbone supplies local judging; it is not the gold verifier. Two continuations cannot identify a reliable oracle action.
transition: Audit all calls and outcomes, then compare candidate availability and frozen selector value. No automatic promotion from eight problems or same-sample oracle maxima.
